usedFor: Shopify holds orders and PostGrid Print & Mail sends physical letters, so “Order Cancelled” can trigger “Send Letter”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Letter” in PostGrid Print & Mail
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order can get a personalized letter by mail, with no one typing it out.

watchOut: “Send Letter” reaches a customer outside your team, so it waits in Needs you until you approve it.
